part.name: Exploded modular hotend and heater-block assembly
part.description: Nine-solid mechanical assembly comprising two manifold or heat-sink bodies, two heater or clamp blocks, a support carriage, a tubular heat break, and three interchangeable threaded nozzle or fitting variants. Visible functional features include stepped mounting bores, cross-passages, split clamp slots, heat-dissipation fins, threaded interfaces, hex wrench flats, internal flow passages, chamfers, and stress-relieving corner blends. STEP face assignments are based on face geometry, bounding boxes, axes, areas, and correspondence with the labeled views.
part.symmetry_note: Most individual components exhibit bilateral or rotational symmetry about their principal bore axes. The finned heat sink is approximately symmetric left-to-right but is interrupted by side holes and front-to-back fin geometry. The clamp and heater blocks are asymmetric because of slots, cross-holes, and offset mounting holes. The three nozzle or fitting components are rotationally symmetric above their hexagonal wrench sections.

Section.name: Five-port manifold block
features included: five visible top ports including four corner ports and one central port
Section.function intent: Provides a rigid multi-port interface for locating and connecting heater, coolant, pneumatic, or extrusion-flow elements while accepting transverse fasteners.
Section.physical behavior: The thick prismatic shell reacts clamping and pressure loads. Stepped bores locate mating cylindrical parts and provide fastener-head clearance, while the chamfered lower profile removes unnecessary mass and improves access. Corner rounds reduce local stress concentration.
Section.geometry: Tall approximately 30 by 21 by 25 mm prismatic manifold with a rectangular upper region, a tapered or chamfered lower front region, five axial stepped bores, four small cross-holes, and blended vertical corners.
Section.location: Upper-left component in the exploded isometric view; STEP SOLID 0, bbox x=-55 to -25, y=-21 to 0, z=0 to 25.

features included: stack of eleven transverse cooling fins
large front and rear datum planes
Section.function intent: Conducts heat away from installed cylindrical elements while providing a rigid mounting interface and forced- or natural-convection cooling area.
Section.physical behavior: The thick central body conducts heat from the bores into the repeated thin fins. The fins increase exposed area and shed heat to air. Large stepped bores locate cartridges or heat-break elements, while small threaded holes clamp covers or attach the block to a frame.
Section.geometry: Approximately 32 by 18 by 30 mm rectangular heat-sink body with repeated full-width horizontal fins over most of its height, two large stepped vertical bores, smaller mounting holes, and flat side walls.

Section.name: Chamfered support carriage

Section.function intent: Acts as a structural carriage or mounting yoke that locates cylindrical members and transfers their loads into a wider mounting footprint.

Section.name: Tubular heat break

Section.function intent: Provides a coaxial material-flow or thermal transition between a cooled support and a heated block while limiting conductive heat transfer.
